notes.title: Trading cards
notes.notes:
Dear friends.
According to unchecked information, which now walks among indie publishers in Steam, to activate collectible cards the game must score [b] 300 or more reviews [/ b]. It is desirable, not extremely negative.))
Therefore, please everyone who is interested in the cards and backgrounds in our game, spend 3 minutes of their time and write a short review.
Thank you for your understanding and support.

notes.title: Added new achievements!
notes.notes:
Including one hidden achievement.
Also, now the game starts immediately in full screen mode. In windowed mode without borders, you can go through Alt + Enter.

notes.title: Installation of beautiful fonts in the Russian style.
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30560177/789e1cbad6940c055a23c1fa306811936f702493.png[/img]
	
[b]In the game, you can replace the standard font with a font in a beautiful Russian style.
To do this, install the file [u]a_RussDecor.ttf[/u] from the archive [u]fonts.zip[/u] in the folder with the installed game at \ SteamLibrary \ steamapps \ common \ Matryoshka Strike.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30560177/51497c1de29f1cd60d586d51157c6a8abd7f0e41.png[/img]

notes.title: Day-One Patch!
notes.notes:

The error of achievements at an infinite level is also fixed.
